spells.name: Animate Objects
spells.description: Animate nonmagical objects (not Gargantuan). Max objects = spellcasting modifier (M/S:1, L:2, H:3). They become Constructs using the Animated Object stat block. Share your Initiative and act after you. Mental command as a Bonus Action.

spells.name: Antilife Shell
spells.description: A 10ft Emanation prevents creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reaching through. Ends if you force a creature through it.

spells.name: Awaken
spells.description: Grant Intelligence (10) and speech to a Huge- Beast or Plant. Plants gain mobility and stats. Target is Charmed for 30 days.

spells.name: Banishing Smite
spells.description: Next hit deals extra 5d10 Force damage. If target has 50 HP or fewer after hit, it is banished (to home plane if extraplanar, or harmless demiplane for duration).

spells.name: Bigby's Hand
spells.description: Create Large force hand (AC 20, HP = your max HP). Bonus Action: move 60ft and choose: Clenched Fist (5d8 Force), Forceful Hand (push), Grasping Hand (grapple + 4d6+mod damage), or Interposing Hand (Half Cover + Difficult Terrain).

spells.name: Circle of Power
spells.description: 30ft Emanation. You and allies in it have Advantage on saves vs spells/magic effects. If a save results in half damage, you instead take no damage.

spells.name: Cloudkill
spells.description: 20ft-radius Sphere of poisonous fog (Heavily Obscured). Moves 10ft away each turn. Entering or starting turn inside: Constitution save or 5d8 Poison damage (half on success).

spells.name: Commune
spells.description: Ask three Yes/No questions to a deity. Correct answers provided. DM may answer 'Unclear'.

spells.name: Commune with Nature
spells.description: Learn 3 facts about territory within 3 miles (outdoors) or 300ft (caves): terrain, plants/peoples, Celestials/Fiends, extraplanar influence, or buildings.

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.description: Each creature in 60ft cone makes a Constitution save. Fail: 8d8 Cold damage. Success: half damage. Slain creatures become frozen statues until they thaw.

spells.name: Conjure Elemental
spells.description: Summon spirit (Air, Earth, Fire, or Water). Creatures entering or starting turn within 5ft make a Dexterity save. Fail: 8d8 damage (Lightning, Thunder, Fire, or Cold) and Restrained. Restrained target takes 4d8 damage at start of turn until they save.

spells.name: Conjure Volley
spells.description: Hundreds of spectral copies fall in a 40ft-radius, 20ft-high Cylinder. Each creature makes a Dexterity save. Fail: 8d8 Force damage. Success: half damage.

spells.name: Contact Other Plane
spells.description: Contact extraplanar entity. Make DC 15 Intelligence save. Fail: 6d6 Psychic damage and Incapacitated until Long Rest. Success: ask 5 one-word questions.

spells.name: Contagion
spells.description: Melee spell attack: 4d8 Necrotic damage and Poisoned. Target repeats Constitution save at end of turns. 3 successes: ends. 3 failures: Poisoned for duration and suffer a chosen disease (e.g., Blinding Sickness, Slimy Doom).

spells.name: Creation
spells.description: Form nonmagical object from Shadowfell (max 5ft Cube). Duration based on material: Vegetable (1d), Stone/Crystal (12h), Precious Metal (1h), Gems (10m), Adamantine/Mithral (1m).

spells.name: Destructive Wave
spells.description: 30ft Emanation. Chosen creatures make a Constitution save. Fail: 5d6 Thunder + 5d6 Radiant/Necrotic damage and Prone. Success: half damage only.

spells.name: Dispel Evil and Good
spells.description: Extraplanars have Disadvantage on attacks against you. End early to Break Enchantment (end Charmed/Frightened/Possession) or Dismiss (force target to home plane with a Charisma save).

spells.name: Dominate Person
spells.description: Force a Wisdom save on a Humanoid. Fail: Charmed and you have a telepathic link to issue commands. Use your Action for precise control. Repeats save on damage.

spells.name: Dream
spells.description: Contact known creature in its sleep. Messenger can converse or be terrifying (Wisdom save or 3d6 Psychic damage and no rest benefits).

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.description: 40ft-tall, 10ft-radius Cylinder. Creatures make a Dexterity save. Fail: 5d6 Fire + 5d6 Radiant damage. Success: half damage.

spells.name: Geas
spells.description: Give a command. Target makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed and takes 5d10 Psychic damage if it acts against the command (max 1/day). Suicidal commands end the spell. Ends with Remove Curse or Greater Restoration.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.description: Remove one: 1 level of Exhaustion, Charmed, Petrified, a curse, ability score reduction, or HP max reduction.

spells.name: Hallow
spells.description: Infuse 60ft-radius area. Designated creature types (Celestials, Fey, etc.) can't enter or possess/Charm/Frighten those inside. Bind one extra effect (e.g., Courage, Darkness, Energy Resistance).

spells.name: Hold Monster
spells.description: Target makes a Wisdom save or is Paralyzed (no effect on Undead). Repeat save at end of its turns.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature (within 30ft) for each level above 5.

spells.name: Insect Plague
spells.description: 20ft-radius Sphere (Lightly Obscured, Difficult Terrain). Entering/starting turn inside: Constitution save or 4d10 Piercing damage (half on success).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d10 per level above 5.

spells.name: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance
spells.description: 10ft-radius, 40ft-high Cylinder. Creatures inside are Blinded and Deafened and can't use Verbal components. Entering/starting turn inside: Constitution save or 2d10 Radiant + 2d10 Thunder damage (half on success).
spells.upcast: Both damages increase by 1d10 per level above 5.

spells.name: Legend Lore
spells.description: Receive lore about a famous person, place, or object you name or describe.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.description: Heal up to six creatures in a 30ft-radius Sphere for 5d8 + spellcasting modifier. No effect on Undead/Constructs.
spells.upcast: Healing increases by 1d8 per level above 5.

spells.name: Mislead
spells.description: Become Invisible and create an illusory double. Double is intangible/invulnerable. Use Magic action to move it and see/hear through it. Invisibility ends if you attack/damage/cast.

spells.name: Modify Memory
spells.description: Target makes Wisdom save (Adv if fighting). Fail: Charmed, Incapacitated, and unaware. Modify one memory (<10m) from last 24h.

spells.name: Passwall
spells.description: Create passage (5ft wide, 8ft high, 20ft deep) in wood, plaster, or stone. Safe ejection when ends.

spells.name: Planar Binding
spells.description: Target Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend makes Charisma save. Fail: bound to your service for duration. Extends summoning spell durations.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.description: Revive creature dead <10 days (not Undead). Returns with 1 HP. Neutralizes poisons, closes mortal wounds (no missing parts). Target has -4 penalty to D20 tests, reduced by 1 per Long Rest.

spells.name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
spells.description: Forge telepathic link with up to eight willing creatures in range. They must know a language. No distance limit (same plane only).

spells.name: Reincarnate
spells.description: Touch creature dead <10 days. Forms new body; roll 1d10 for species (Aasimar, Dragonborn, Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Goliath, Halfling, Human, Orc, Tiefling). Retains former memories/capabilities but replaces species traits.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.description: See/hear creature on same plane. Target makes Wisdom save (modifier based on knowledge/connection). Fail: sensor follows them and you see/hear through it.

spells.name: Seeming
spells.description: Disguise chosen creatures in range. Bodies and gear can be changed. Unwilling targets make Charisma save. Study action (Investigation) vs spell DC to see through.

spells.name: Songal's Elemental Suffusion
spells.description: Gain Resistance to chosen element (Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder), 30ft Fly Speed (hover), and 15ft Emanation burst (Dex save or 2d6 damage + Prone, half on success). Burst occurs when cast and at start of turns.

spells.name: Steel Wind Strike
spells.description: Make melee spell attacks against up to five creatures. On hit: 6d10 Force damage. Teleport to unoccupied space within 5ft of a target.

spells.name: Summon Celestial
spells.description: Summon Celestial spirit (Avenger or Defender). Shares your Initiative (acts after you). Obeys verbal commands. Stat block scales with level.
spells.upcast: Stat block scales with spell level.

spells.name: Summon Dragon
spells.description: Summon Dragon spirit. Shares your Initiative (acts after you). Obeys verbal commands. Stat block scales with level.
spells.upcast: Stat block scales with spell level.

spells.name: Swift Quiver
spells.description: Quiver produces endless nonmagical ammo. Make two attacks with a weapon using that ammo as a Bonus Action each turn.

spells.name: Synaptic Static
spells.description: 20ft-radius Sphere burst. Creatures (Int > 2) make Intelligence save. Fail: 8d6 Psychic damage and subtract 1d6 from attacks/checks/Concentration for 1 minute. Success: half damage only. Repeat save at end of turns.

spells.name: Telekinesis
spells.description: Use Magic action to move/manipulate Huge- creature/object. Creature: Strength save or moved 30ft and Restrained until end of your next turn. Object: move 30ft (if worn/carried, creature makes Strength save).

spells.name: Teleportation Circle
spells.description: Inscribe 5ft-radius circle linking to a permanent circle on same plane. Portal opens for 1 round. Permanent if cast daily for 1 year.

spells.name: Tree Stride
spells.description: Move between trees of same kind (within 500ft). Living and at least your size. Costs 5ft movement to enter. Ends turn outside tree.

spells.name: Wall of Force
spells.description: Create invisible wall of force (dome/sphere radius 10ft, or ten 10x10ft panels). Immune to all damage, cannot be dispelled. Disintegrate destroys it.

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.description: Create supporting nonmagical stone wall (ten 10x10ft panels). Panels AC 15, 30 HP/inch. Permanent if concentration maintained for duration.

spells.name: Yolande's Regal Presence
spells.description: 10ft Emanation. Creatures entering or starting turn inside make a Wisdom save. Fail: 4d6 Psychic damage, Prone, and pushed 10ft. Success: half damage only.

spells.name: Control Winds
spells.description: Control air in a 100ft Cube. Choose: **Gusts** (disperse fog/extinguish flames), **Downdraft** (flying creatures make Str save or fall Prone), or **Updraft** (up to 10ft extra jump/movement and half fall damage).

spells.name: Create Spelljamming Helm
spells.description: Permanently transform a Large- nonmagical chair into a spelljamming helm for piloting ships.

spells.name: Danse Macabre
spells.description: Animate up to five S/M corpses as Skeletons/Zombies. They gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to your spellcasting modifier. Command all as a Bonus Action.
spells.upcast: Animate two additional corpses for each level above 5.

spells.name: Dawn
spells.description: 30ft-radius, 40ft-high Cylinder of sunlight. Creatures in or entering make a Constitution save or take 4d10 Radiant damage (half on success). Bonus Action: move it 60ft.

spells.name: Enervation
spells.description: Drain life from a creature. Target makes a Dexterity save. Fail: 4d8 Necrotic damage and you heal half. Success: 2d8 damage and spell ends. If failed, use Action each turn for automatic 4d8 damage and healing.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d8 per level above 5.

spells.name: Far Step
spells.description: Teleport up to 60ft to an unoccupied space. Bonus Action on later turns to teleport again.

spells.name: Holy Weapon
spells.description: Imbue weapon with light (30ft Bright, +30ft Dim). Attacks deal extra 2d8 Radiant damage. Bonus Action: dismiss for 4d8 Radiant burst and Blindness (Con save) within 30ft.

spells.name: Immolation
spells.description: Wreathe creature in fire. Target makes a Dexterity save. Fail: 8d6 Fire damage and burns (4d6 Fire damage at end of turns; repeat save). Success: half damage and no burning. Slain targets turn to ash.

spells.name: Infernal Calling
spells.description: Summon a devil (CR 6-). It is unfriendly. Persuade it with Charisma (Persuasion) vs its Wisdom (Insight) to obey commands. Vanishes at 0 HP or when spell ends.
spells.upcast: CR increases by 1 for each level above 5.

spells.name: Maelstrom
spells.description: 30ft-radius swirling water (Difficult Terrain). Creatures starting turn inside make a Strength save or take 6d6 Bludgeoning damage and are pulled 10ft toward center.

spells.name: Negative Energy Flood
spells.description: Blast target with negative energy. Living: Constitution save or 5d12 Necrotic damage (half on success). Kills rise as Zombies. Undead: gain Temp HP (half of 5d12 roll).

spells.name: Skill Empowerment
spells.description: Grant a proficient creature Expertise in one skill.

spells.name: Temporal Shunt
spells.description: Take a Reaction when creature attacks or casts. Target makes a Wisdom save or vanishes until start of its next turn. Attack/spell is wasted.
spells.upcast: Target one additional creature (within 30ft) for each level above 5.

spells.name: Transmute Rock
spells.description: 40ft Cube of rock to mud or mud to rock. **Rock to Mud:** Difficult Terrain (4:1 cost); creatures make Strength save or are Restrained. **Mud to Rock:** Dexterity save to avoid being Restrained in stone.

spells.name: Wall of Light
spells.description: Wall of light (60ft long, 10ft high). Creatures in area make a Constitution save or take 4d8 Radiant damage and are Blinded for 1 min. Repeat damage if ending turn in wall. Action: fire 4d8 radiant beam (shortens wall 10ft).

spells.name: Wrath of Nature
spells.description: 60ft Cube of animated nature. Effects: Difficult Terrain for enemies; trees deal 4d6 Slashing (Dex save); vines restrain (Str save); bonus action rocks (ranged attack, 3d8 Bludgeoning + Prone).
